name: jsdotnet-design-ux-guidelines
description: Five skills for working with the jsdotnet-design-ux-guidelines MCP server: UX style guide, design tokens (color, typography, spacing, motion). Covers token lookup, UI component styling, project color customization, and server smoke-testing.

skills.title: JSdotNet Design & UX MCP
skills.description: Reference guide for the jsdotnet-design-ux-guidelines MCP server: style-guide catalog, tool reference, token categories, and example workflows for color, typography, spacing, and motion.

skills.title: Design Token Lookup
skills.description: Look up design tokens by category (color, typography, spacing, motion). Find the right token name, its light/dark values, and usage rules before writing any CSS or style code.

skills.title: UI Component Styling
skills.description: Style UI components using the design token system. Covers button states, form inputs, cards, typography hierarchy, semantic feedback (success/warning/error), and accessibility rules.

skills.title: Design Customization
skills.description: Customize the project color scheme by overriding brand and semantic color tokens. Covers which tokens may be overridden, contrast requirements, and the override contract.

skills.title: Test Design & UX Server
skills.description: Smoke-test the jsdotnet-design-ux-guidelines MCP server to verify it is connected, serving the correct style-guide content, and that all tools work end-to-end.
